description: Layer 1 - Edge Fixes: Remove duplicate CORS from backend, clean bot.ts blocking logic, consolidate rate limiting to edge-only burst enforcement
steps: 1. In apps/backend/app/main.py, REMOVE the CORSMiddleware import and the entire app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, ...) block (lines that add CORSMiddleware with allow_origins, allow_credentials, allow_methods, allow_headers). The edge worker (apps/edge/src/middleware/cors.ts) already handles CORS for all traffic. Keep the import of FastAPI, Request, etc.

2. In apps/edge/src/index.ts, locate the bot detection section (around line 60-70) where it checks User-Agent with regex /bot|crawl|spider|scrape|curl|wget|python-requests|httpie/i. Currently it sets X-Bot-Detected header. REMOVE ANY blocking logic for bots in this section. The code currently only tags (sets X-Bot-Detected: true) which is correct for ISR routing. Verify there is NO return statement or 403 response for bot-detected requests in this section.

3. In apps/backend/app/api/deps/rate_limit.py, REMOVE the burst rate limiting logic. The function should ONLY perform monthly quota tracking. Specifically: remove BURST_LIMIT_FREE and BURST_LIMIT_PRO constants, remove the burst_key logic, remove the burst_count check. When edge_rate_limited is True (X-Rate-Limited-By: edge header present), skip ALL per-request enforcement and only track monthly quota. When edge_rate_limited is False (direct backend access, e.g., in tests), keep the monthly quota check only.

4. In apps/backend/app/core/rate_limiter.py, add a comment at the top noting this module is DEPRECATED for per-request enforcement (edge handles burst limits). It is retained only for the monthly quota Lua script pattern used by apps/backend/app/api/deps/rate_limit.py. Alternatively, if rate_limiter.py is not imported anywhere except as a standalone utility, mark it clearly as legacy.

5. In apps/edge/src/index.ts, verify that the X-Rate-Limited-By header is set to 'edge' after rate limit check passes (already done around line 107-109). This signals to the backend that edge already enforced burst limits.
acceptance_criteria: Backend main.py no longer imports or adds CORSMiddleware
Edge bot detection only tags requests (X-Bot-Detected header) without blocking/returning 403
Backend rate_limit.py (deps) only tracks monthly quota, no burst limit enforcement
Backend still trusts X-Rate-Limited-By: edge header and skips enforcement when present
All existing tests pass with updated logic (mocks may need adjustment)

Run: cd /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya/apps/backend && python -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('app/api/deps/rate_limit.py').read()); print('rate_limit.py valid')"
Run: cd /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya/apps/edge && npx tsc --noEmit src/index.ts 2>/dev/null || echo 'TS check skipped (no tsconfig)'
findings: Used pyenv global 3.11.15 to activate Python. All AST validation passed. No tests reference removed CORS or burst constants. Edge bot detection was already tag-only (no blocking). X-Rate-Limited-By header was already set at edge line ~107.
